correctness.rationale: For |G|=p^(l+b) and expG=p^l, every element order <=p^l gives F_k<=p^(-kb). If l>b, split G=C_{p^l}xH with |H|=p^b: elements with first-coordinate order>p^b contribute p^b*(psi_k(C_{p^l})-psi_k(C_{p^b})), all others contribute psi_k(C_{p^b}xH). The cyclic geometric sum yields F_k=c_{p,k}p^(-kb)+E_{p,k}(H)/p^((k+1)(l+b)), 0<E<=2p^((k+2)b). Thus fixed b and l->infinity yield the stated limit uniformly over H. A positive F_k limit bounds b; distinct subsequence limits force eventual single integer b, giving all-moment rigidity. b->infinity forces all zero. Explicit sequences realize each candidate. Independent exact fractions for four invariant-factor types confirmed the decomposition and error bound; asymptotic exhaustion uses proof not tests.
